title: mAVE: A Watermark for Joint Audio-Visual Generation Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.07090v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Watermarking joint audio-visual generation supports vendor copyright protection and content provenance. However, independently valid audio and video watermarks do not establish a shared generation session. An adversary can splice watermarked modalities from different sessions, causing the pair to be mistaken for the vendor's original joint output. We introduce mAVE (Manifold Audio-Visual Entanglement), a training-free watermarking framework that strengthens vendor attribution through session binding in native joint audio-visual diffusion transformers. mAVE separates public record retrieval from secret session authentication: a fixed public index locates the server record, while a randomized payload binds audio bits to a session-keyed video grid through a cryptographic digest. One prompt-conditioned joint inversion supports provider-assisted verification of both modalities against a session record, without modifying generator we

translated_title: mAVE：面向联合音视频生成模型的数字水印
translated_abstract: 联合音视频生成的水印技术可支持厂商版权保护与内容溯源。然而，各自独立有效的音频水印和视频水印并不能建立共享的生成会话。攻击者可以从不同会话中拼接带有水印的模态，使这一对内容被误认为是厂商的原始联合输出。我们提出了 mAVE（流形音视频纠缠，Manifold Audio-Visual Entanglement），一个免训练的水印框架，通过在原生联合音视频扩散 Transformer 中实现会话绑定来强化厂商归属。mAVE 将公开记录检索与秘密会话认证相分离：一个固定的公开索引用于定位服务器记录，而一个随机化的载荷通过密码学摘要将音频比特绑定到以会话密钥为键的视频网格上。只需一次基于提示条件的联合反演，即可支持针对会话记录对两种模态进行厂商辅助验证，且无需修改生成器权重……
tldr: mAVE 提出了一种免训练的联合音视频水印框架，通过密码学摘要将音频比特绑定到会话密钥的视频网格上，实现音视频输出的会话级绑定，防止攻击者跨会话拼接带水印的模态并强化厂商归属验证。
en_tdlr: mAVE is a training-free watermarking framework that cryptographically binds audio bits to a session-keyed video grid, preventing cross-session splicing of watermarked modalities and strengthening vendor attribution for joint audio-visual diffusion transformers.
